decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-4e7b065b85d5], says the legacy `--log_rotate_*` flags were removed and points users to external log rotation tools. It does not say what happens to a component that is still started with these flags. The component might ignore them quietly (setting-ignored) or reject the unknown flag and fail to start (workload-failure), and the evidence supports neither. To decide the kind and severity we need the flag-parsing behaviour after removal, for example the PR or code diff for drop-log-rotate, or a test showing how the affected binaries handle an unknown `--log_rotate_*` flag.
